say:6:1210417004:0.text: Master Hugin, I don't know if you know, but we actually had to escape from Darkstone Cave. The Whispers thought we were Water Wights and treated us like prisoners.
say:6:1210417004:0.source_cn: 咳咳……呼金先生，不知道你知不知道，其实我们是从血薇帮...

say:8:1210417005:1.text: Ever since arriving in Rustport, we've been tricked, chased, and lied to. Chippy almost drowned...
say:8:1210417005:1.source_cn: 自从来到锈锚港，又是落水，又是被追杀，满满已经精疲力尽了……

say:9:1210417006:1.text: Even if the enchantment works and the Whispers defeat the Dead Tide Fleet, we would still be captives... Will the Whispers let us go?
say:9:1210417006:1.source_cn: 就算附魔成功，血薇帮用秘密武器成功打败死潮舰队，我们也...

say:10:1210417007:1.text: Master Hugin is such a nice person, and Hardhead and the others are so friendly. Chippy thinks they'll help us if we ask them to.
say:10:1210417007:1.source_cn: 呼金先生人这么大方，铁头他们又如此热情，怎么可能让他的...

say:11:1210417008:1.text: If someone could confirm we're not Water Wights and prove our innocence...
say:11:1210417008:1.source_cn: 唉……如果有人能帮我们洗刷水鬼的污名，证明我们是无辜的……

say:12:1210417009:1.text: Even Hardhead can see that you're all good people!
say:12:1210417009:1.source_cn: 啊？无辜还需要证明吗？铁头都看得出来你们是善良正直的人！

say:15:1210417011:0.text: I can't watch this any longer. Hugin won't understand if you beat around the bush. Just tell him straight.
say:15:1210417011:0.source_cn: 哈！我看不下去了。你们可以说明白些，绕弯子的话呼金听不懂的。

say:16:1210417012:0.text: Master Hugin, of course we'll help you with your enchantments. But could you tell the Whispers to stop chasing us and calling us Water Wights?
say:16:1210417012:0.source_cn: 好吧，呼金先生，要想我们帮你附魔，可以。前提是你帮我们...

say:17:1210417013:0.text: Also, after that, we would like a ship to take us to Cedartown.
say:17:1210417013:0.source_cn: 对，事成之后，还要给我们船，送我们去雪松镇。

say:19:1210417014:0.text: Oh yes, that's fine! I can do that. I was worried that the enchantment wouldn't work. I was about to tear my hair out!
say:19:1210417014:0.source_cn: 太好了！原来是这事。我还担心附魔成不了，寒毛都竖起来了！

say:20:1210417015:0.text: Don't worry. I'll take care of it.
say:20:1210417015:0.source_cn: 别担心，这件事就包在我身上！小意思！
